newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian MBA takes job search to radio.
newsitem.headline: Canadian MBA takes job search to radio.

text.p: A Canadian who cannot find full-time work despite having a master's degree in business administration is spending C$1,300 (US$960) to advertise on the radio for a job.
Stuart Weinstein, 30, has taken out 16 radio spots on Toronto AM station CFRB advertising his availability for work. The ads start next Monday.

His job-seeking campaign has also included donning a cow costume -- to draw attention to himself -- to hand out copies of his resume in Toronto's financial district. He has worked as a financial analyst, research assistant and government consultant but has never held a permanent full-time job.
"I feel confident that there is full-time employment out there and I'm looking diligently to find it," he said.
